# Optional OSS attribution and license boundaries

Checked 2026-11-03. The kit's own glue code remains MIT; installed third-party files retain their original licenses. No third-party implementation was copied into tools/property_checks.py. The two license texts here are unmodified copies from the reviewed official wheels.

- Hypothesis 6.170.14: Copyright (c) 2013, David R. MacIver and the Hypothesis Authors; MPL-2.0. [Official source](https://github.com/HypothesisWorks/hypothesis), [exact source release](https://pypi.org/project/hypothesis/6.170.14/#files), [license text](licenses/Hypothesis-LICENSE.txt). Obtain the corresponding source archive through the exact source URL and SHA-256 in [the adoption ledger](../docs/OSS_ADOPTION.md). Package-file notices, including exceptions for code originating elsewhere, remain in the installed distribution and source archive. This project does not modify those files or relicense them as MIT.
- Sorted Containers 2.4.0: Copyright 2014-2019 Grant Jenks; Apache-2.0. [Official source](https://github.com/grantjenks/python-sortedcontainers), [exact source release](https://pypi.org/project/sortedcontainers/2.4.0/#files), [license text](licenses/sortedcontainers-LICENSE.txt). The reviewed wheel includes LICENSE and no separate NOTICE file. Preserve original headers/notices and any applicable NOTICE when redistributing a different artifact/version.

The reviewed Hypothesis wheel also has a license file and no separate NOTICE. Wheels and source archives are stored only under ignored .local data; they are not added to the public source package. If a wheelhouse is redistributed later, include the original distributions, license/attribution notices and corresponding source availability required by MPL-2.0. Copying a public URL alone does not turn third-party code into MIT material.
